description: This file defines the SocketAuthHelper class, which implements a simple socket-based authentication protocol used within Apache Spark for local or encrypted socket communication.

classes.name: SocketAuthHelper
classes.description: A helper class providing socket authentication using a secret, supporting both client and server-side authentication.

methods.name: authClient
methods.description: Authenticates a client socket by verifying the secret sent over the socket.

methods.name: authToServer
methods.description: Authenticates with a server by sending the secret and verifying the server's reply.

methods.name: readUtf8
methods.description: Reads a UTF-8 encoded string from a socket input stream.

methods.name: writeUtf8
methods.description: Writes a UTF-8 encoded string to a socket output stream.
